description: M5 control for lp at k=99999 (all labels): the external-data replay (cars_full_external / in_shop_full_external, 1000 epochs, patience 20) with no external images. unlabeled_source='split' attaches no pool, and at k=99999 the split leaves 0 unlabeled candidates, so LP's generate_pseudo_labels returns an empty result every epoch and each fold trains on the labeled set only with LP's tuned hyperparameters.
name: full_external_0_iscen
